name: MoveFile
label: Move File(s)
description: Moves one or more files to a destination folder. Supports wildcards and multiple source paths separated by semicolons.

fields.name: SourceFiles
fields.label: File(s) to Move
fields.description: The path(s) of the file(s) to move, separated by semicolons (;). Supports wildcards. Examples: C:\Temp\report.pdf | C:\Temp\*.txt;C:\Archive\old_*.docx

fields.name: DestinationFolder
fields.label: Destination Folder
fields.description: The full path of the destination folder. The folder will be created if it does not exist. Example: C:\Output\Processed

fields.name: IfExistsAction
fields.label: If File Exists
fields.description: The action to take when a file with the same name already exists in the destination. Options: DoNothing (skip the file), Overwrite (delete and replace). Default: DoNothing.

selectOptions.label: Do nothing
selectOptions.description: Skips the file if it already exists.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite
selectOptions.description: Deletes the existing file and moves the new file.

fields.name: MovedFile
fields.label: Moved File
fields.description: The destination path of the last successfully moved file.
